response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0), project_rates AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM scan_rates GROUP BY arcref, fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS bench_rate FROM project_rates), projects_with_gap AS (SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.avg_rate, pr.avg_rate - b.bench_rate AS gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.avg_rate > b.bench_rate) SELECT arcref, fundflux, avg_rate, gap FROM projects_with_gap ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
